## 94ff484354c0

**Reproduced defect: declared palette controls are inert.** Generator SHA-256
`db83675b2b6b122a5e8c1f580a99f7e45c7d113583f69cb916eb41d959317aad`,
version `1.2.0`, advertises `palette_kind=default|warm|cool|varied` and exposes the
same values as helpful `texture` controls. For seed `20261004`, sample index `7`,
medium difficulty, `palette_kind=warm` and `palette_kind=cool` produce byte-identical
lawful grids. `texture=warm` and `texture=cool` are likewise identical. The source
accepts those controls but never consumes either value in normal generation.

The exact input passes `self_check` with no errors. The supported Racket apply
record executed canonical rule hash `8c9447620958` and returned a valid output;
therefore this is a generator API/distribution defect, not an invalid-input
artifact. Reproducer and full grids:
`checks/audit/94ff484354c0/control-reproducer.json`; authority record:
`checks/audit/94ff484354c0/racket.json`. The audit target was not modified.
